start: ^Rabbi, look! The tree You cursed yesterday... it's completely withered! From the roots up!

c-0: ^I've seen blights take a season to kill a tree, but this? This was overnight. One word from the Master and life just... departed.
c-1: ^Because it was a liar, friend. It stood there with its leaves spread wide, promising fruit to a hungry man, but it was empty inside.

miracle: ^It makes you realize who we're really walking with. He didn't just teach us a lesson; He showed us He has authority over the very earth we stand on.
^What did He say about the mountain?

c-0: ^He said if we have faith and do not doubt, we could tell this mountain to throw itself into the sea. I'm starting to think He wasn't exaggerating.

faith: ^"Have faith in God," He told us. It sounds simple, but watching that tree turn to dust... it's a heavy kind of simple.
judgment: ^The Master is entering Jerusalem to face the leaders. That tree is a mirror. It looks healthy from a distance, just like the Temple rituals, but there's no fruit for God there.
